name: Sabo
title: Build an unshakable board and lead your revolution!
desc:
The Leader effect, which protects Characters with 5000+ power, is hugely compatible with Blockers.

After you've built up your side of the board through solid defense, use Karasu's power-subtraction effect to turn the tables!

cards.name: Sabo
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] If your Character with 5000 power or more would be K.O.'d, you may give that Character −1000 power during this turn instead of that Character being K.O.'d.

cards.name: Otama
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Belo Betty
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Revolutionary Army} type card other than [Belo Betty] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Koala
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Revolutionary Army} type, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −3000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro
cards.text: [Rush] (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

cards.name: Bartolomeo
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Borsalino
cards.text:
[Opponent's Turn] This Character gains +1000 power and cannot be K.O.'d by effects.
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Karasu
cards.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has the {Revolutionary Army} type, give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards −1000 power during this turn.
[When Attacking] If this Character has 7000 power or more, give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards −1000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Lindbergh
cards.text: [When Attacking] If this Character has 7000 power or more, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 power or less.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If your Leader is multicolored, play this card.

cards.name: Hina
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Block] Select up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less. The selected Character cannot attack during this turn.

cards.name: Sabo
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Play] None of your Characters can be K.O.'d by effects until the start of your next turn. Then, draw 2 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand.

cards.name: Sabo
cards.text: [On Play] K.O. up to 2 of your opponent's Characters with a total power of 4000 or less.

cards.name: Fire Fist
cards.text: [Main] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −4000 power during this turn. Then, if you have 2 or less Life cards, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 0 power or less.

cards.name: Round Table
cards.text: [Main] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −10000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Gum-Gum Jet Pistol
cards.text: [Main] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 6000 power or less.
